remarks: Beautiful top-floor condo in desirable West Norwalk close to everything! Just minutes from Darien and Rowayton train stations as well as shopping and restaurants! This spacious condo features an open floor plan, kitchen with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, dining room that opens to the living room, primary suite with walk in closet and full bath, second bedroom, another full bath, vaulted ceilings! Enjoy the convenience of elevator access and a secure garage with two spaces! No pets, or smoking and must have a credit score of 750 or above. There is a storage unit for the condo.
